title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: binding a quoted cover
content:
## Situation of use

This entry belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. It applies when a quoted CargoCare or declared value cover is bound at the cover holder's instruction, and it governs the insured value the cover is bound for.

## Scope boundary

1. This entry governs the binding of a cover whose premium is settled after binding.
2. A cover whose holder's credit status is cash in advance, under a product that requires prepayment, has its premium received before binding; such a cover is outside this entry, and equally outside the charging and settlement of premium that follow binding.
3. Within that scope every other binding gate of the cover eligibility rules still applies, including the binding deadline counted back from the booking's scheduled departure date and the bar on binding a CargoCare product for a holder on credit hold.

## What the tool does

bind_cargo_cover_f980fecc is used on a cover still in the quoted state, at the cover holder's instruction. One call changes the cover's status from quoted to active, dates the binding today and records the insured value the cover is bound for, replacing the value carried on the quote. No premium is charged and nothing is paid by this call. On success the cover holder can be told the cover is in force, its binding date and the insured value bound.

## How it is invoked

bind_cargo_cover_f980fecc is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the desk agent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| cover_id | Cover reference number of the quoted cover being bound, as returned by the cover lookup | Identifier |
| booking_id | Booking reference number of the shipment the cover attaches to, as returned by the booking lookup or shown on the cover | Identifier |
| customer_id | Customer reference number of the cover holder, as returned by the customer profile lookup | Identifier |
| insured_value_usd | Insured value the cover is bound for | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

On success the tool returns: status ("bound" when the cover was updated); cover_id; cover_status (active); bound_date (the binding date, YYYY-MM-DD); insured_value_usd (the value bound, USD with 2 decimal places).

## Basis Q&A

**Does binding charge the premium?** No. The call charges no premium and takes no payment.

**Does the value on the quote survive binding?** The call records the insured value the cover is bound for, replacing the value carried on the quote.
